limitation: The map records parser identities and exact Ovis wrapper evidence; it does not claim repository-wide contrib parity or external module availability.
externalDataDependencies: OpenCV contrib OVIS is disabled unless external OGRE3D is found at version 1.11.5 or later; this package bundles neither OGRE nor an OVIS native/managed wrapper.
OVIS rendering depends on caller-selected scene meshes, textures/material scripts, renderer/window policy, and Mat input/output ownership; none is part of this package contract.
